steps: Install the free Honey browser extension and create or link your account.
Shop as normal at eligible stores so qualifying purchases earn points.
Check your points balance — only eligible purchases count.
Earn at least some points (or stay otherwise active) so your account never hits 12 months of inactivity.
Choose a redemption: PayPal checkout credit, a Honey gift card, or a donation.
Redeem following the offer's threshold, and use the credit before it expires.
